steps.message: Reviewing Dana's Queens library question and intake.

claims.text: Mock rooftop solar (~60,000 kWh/yr) offsets about 19% of 310,000 kWh annual use — solar alone does not reach the 30% goal.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Capital budget USD 400,000 (2026) from intake.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Efficiency and storage paths should be combined to approach the 30% by 2030 target.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: 18,000 sq ft library on a 6,000 sq ft flat roof (replaced 2019) in Queens, NY.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Twelve months of bills total 310,000 kWh on Con Edison SC-9 I (fictional mock tariff).
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Efficiency measures (LED and controls) cut electricity use 10-20% based on published benchmarks, not a building model.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Usable roof fraction 0.55 for setbacks and mechanical zones.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: About 66 sq ft per kW for flat commercial array layout.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Baseline is 310,000 kWh/yr from twelve months of bills.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Start with LED lighting and controls; savings use benchmark percentages until a building model exists (phase 2).
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Benchmark efficiency savings of 10-20% of annual use, see A7.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: C1 usable roof ≈ 3,300 sq ft (6,000 × 0.55).
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: C2 array ≈ 50 kW DC (3,300 ÷ 66).
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: C4 annual bill savings from solar energy ≈ USD 13,000/yr at USD 0.22/kWh.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario A (Efficiency only) cuts grid use 10.0–20.0 % of annual use = 33–67 % of the 30% goal; it does not reach the 30% goal at the low end.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario A upfront cost 72,000–144,000 USD; net cost 72,000–144,000 USD (no incentive counted, see section 7); budget strain: within budget.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario A simple payback 4.8–23.2 years on savings of 6,200–14,880 USD/yr. Simple payback, not the full SAM model.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario A outage backup 0.0–0.0 hours for critical loads. No battery, so solar shuts off in an outage.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario B (Efficiency + solar within budget) cuts grid use 27.7–41.3 % of annual use = 92–138 % of the 30% goal; it does not reach the 30% goal at the low end.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario B upfront cost 222,000–369,000 USD; net cost 222,000–369,000 USD (no incentive counted, see section 7); budget strain: within budget.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario B simple payback 7.2–21.5 years on savings of 17,200–30,720 USD/yr. Simple payback, not the full SAM model.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario B outage backup 0.0–0.0 hours for critical loads. No battery, so solar shuts off in an outage.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario C (Full path to the goal (deep efficiency + full solar + backup battery)) cuts grid use 32.7–46.3 % of annual use = 109–154 % of the 30% goal; it reaches the goal even at the low end.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario C upfront cost 906,000–1,473,000 USD; net cost 906,000–1,473,000 USD (no incentive counted, see section 7); budget strain: over budget.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario C simple payback 26.3–72.6 years on savings of 20,300–34,440 USD/yr. Simple payback, not the full SAM model.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Scenario C outage backup 6.8–8.0 hours for critical loads.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Rooftop solar alone covers only 17.7–21.3% of annual use and does not reach the 30% goal.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Con Edison SC-9 Rate I, effective 2025-07-01, energy charge range. Confirm the tariff against a recent bill.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Federal commercial ITC is listed open with a placed-in-service deadline of 2027-12-31 (retrieved 2025-10-01, saved sample data).
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Net cost counts no incentive: the saved incentive data is sample data (A5), so every program is left out until verified live. Costs use benchmark prices (A9).
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Phase 0, confirm data and budget: upload twelve months of bills, confirm the tariff and the budget year and type.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 1, professional reviews: structural PE/RA analysis and a roof condition survey before any solar design.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 2, efficiency measures: LED and controls first (Scenario A), the cheapest and fastest payback.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 3, permits and interconnection: licensed electrician, FDNY rooftop access review and the Con Edison interconnection application.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 4, solar installation: the roof array sized in Scenario B once reviews pass.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 5, battery, commissioning and verification: add storage if funding allows (Scenario C) and verify savings against bills.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Scenario C battery of 960 kWh supports about 6.8–8.0 hours of the 120 kW critical cooling-center load.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Battery sizing is sample REopt data, not a live optimization.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Scenarios A and B give no backup power: solar panels shut off in an outage without a battery.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Licensed Professional Engineer or Registered Architect structural analysis for rooftop solar loads.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Roof condition survey by a qualified roofing contractor.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: NYC licensed electrician for interconnection and service upgrades.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: FDNY rooftop access review for equipment layout in NYC.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Con Edison utility interconnection review and application.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

sections.title: Path to net-zero and learning resources

claims.text: Rooftop solar plus efficiency may not reach net-zero on this roof; plan off-site renewable procurement for the remainder.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Learn more from NYSERDA and the NYC Accelerator guidance pages (to be confirmed as approved sources in v3).
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Solar-only offset (~18-21%) is below the 30% goal; efficiency is needed, and only Scenario C reaches it at the low end.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Session intake, fictional PVWatts/REopt/utility mocks (v0), and internal calculate tool.
claims.label: FACT
